verdict.rationale: Reactivity model is a fair question for a React-based UI framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents declaring reactive state or having only dependent UI code re-run on change. The cited material covers server components, streaming, routing, caching and optimizations, none of which addresses fine-grained reactivity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can declare reactive state and have only the dependent UI code re-run when it changes
